distinguishing_features: A localized high-inertia ring or sleeve at the crankshaft fillet, rather than monitoring or operational derating.
The proposed mechanism changes local bending-mode frequencies by added inertia without intentionally changing the shaft’s load-bearing section.
The proposal targets reduced dynamic fillet stress through modal detuning.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Reduce cyclic bending stress at the crankshaft fillet without materially reducing its static load-bearing capacity.
parsed.viable_reason: As written, a mass ring without a defined compliant and damped tuning mechanism cannot reliably reduce stress, and the claimed frequency shifts do not establish separation from the actual forcing spectrum.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Although the cited prior arts are unrelated, adding localized mass to shift modal frequencies is a routine vibration-control approach rather than a non-obvious mechanism.
